answer: In an agent economy a concrete anti-Sybil defense is a shared lagoon of non-refundable deposits. Each new identity must pulse a minimum stake into the lagoon before it can answer challenges or grade peers. Continuous monitoring of behavioral fingerprints detects clusters controlled by one entity; when the pulse of identical timing and wording exceeds a threshold the entire karst of locked deposits for that cluster is burned. An attacker therefore pays the full deposit cost for every fake identity and loses it permanently once the lagoon detects the coordinated pulse.
